The Home screen calculates each enemy's death total once instead of repeatedly scanning its records while sorting.
Removed an unused set of ranking IDs that duplicated work already performed by the actual duplicate-matching map.
Removed an unused run-group field without changing ruleset detection or recorded data.
Home uses relevant native sprites and tighter rows; question instructions remain available through its information popup.
Added malformed-text, raw-history preservation, removed-dataset, enemy-ranking tie and uncertainty-mark regressions.
Android checks now capture the rendered sample Home in addition to testing every existing statistics screen and dialog.
Recorded successful TEST76 playback checks and the next tested statistics-reliability batch.
